Third-party assets vendored for POC-08
======================================

This directory contains the Vulkan loader and a software Vulkan ICD so the POC
can run on Windows runners that lack a native Vulkan driver.

The files were sourced from a local Flutter Engine distribution (referencias/)
which itself redistributes the following open-source components:

  vulkan-1.dll
    - Vulkan Loader
    - Copyright (c) 2015-2016 The Khronos Group Inc.
    - License: Apache License, Version 2.0
    - Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Loader

  vk_swiftshader.dll
    - SwiftShader — a CPU-based Vulkan implementation
    - Copyright (c) 2016 Google Inc.
    - License: Apache License, Version 2.0
    - Source: https://github.com/google/swiftshader

  vk_swiftshader_icd.json
    - ICD manifest pointing the Vulkan loader at SwiftShader.
    - The `library_path` is relative to this JSON file (`.\\vk_swiftshader.dll`),
      so the three files must stay together in the same directory.

The Apache 2.0 license permits redistribution, including in binary form, as
long as the LICENSE and NOTICE files (when present) are retained. Full license
texts are available at https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.

These assets exist solely to enable CI validation of POC-08 on Windows
runners; the dart_ui framework itself does not require Vulkan to be present at
runtime.
